b) Reference objects: the corn cobs are roughly 4-5 cm in diameter and the cherry tomatoes about 3 cm. The plate spans roughly 8 cherry-tomato widths across. 8 x 3 = 24 cm.
Both cues agree: width ≈ 24 cm, so area = 24² = 576 cm².
